Design Notes — Identity Lock

  • Pale teal eyes with frost-reddened lids; long white hair in a half-braided crown.
  • Layered white kimono, white collar, pale obi knot with white tassel cord.
  • Towering giant — render at true scale, never shrunk to human height (STYLE_BIBLE_v3 §Scale).
  • Keep the reference's soft dreamy glow, bloom and painterly finish — never flat studio.
  • Pure Edo fantasy; no modern tech.
